**2 — Vessel:** A square dinner plate, approximately 26 cm across. Using the requested circular approximation: area = 3.14 × 13² ≈ **531 cm²**.

**3 — Items:** Corn rounds, leafy greens, cherry tomatoes, cucumber slices and thin carrot strips. No clearly identifiable oil or dressing.

**4–7 — Area, volume, weight and energy:**

| Item | Plate area | Area × height = gross volume | Bulk density | Weight | kcal/100 g | Energy |

| Corn rounds, including cob | 15% | 80 × 2.5 = 200 ml | 0.70 | 140 g | 65* | 91 kcal |
| Leafy greens | 13% | 69 × 2.5 = 173 ml | 0.15 | 26 g | 20 | 5 kcal |
| Cherry tomatoes | 4% | 21 × 2 = 42 ml | 0.60 | 25 g | 18 | 5 kcal |
| Cucumber | 3% | 16 × 0.7 = 11 ml | 0.60 | 7 g | 15 | 1 kcal |
| Carrot strips | 1% | 5 × 0.4 = 2 ml | 0.60 | 1 g | 41 | <1 kcal |

The allocated areas total **36%**, consistent with the substantial empty plate space.

\*Corn energy is averaged over the weight including the inedible cob; only the kernels contribute calories.

**8 — Sanity check:** Approximately **199 g including cobs**, or roughly **155 g edible food**, and **102 kcal** is plausible for the small visible portion. There is no obvious calorie-dense addition.
